turns.user: my dumbbells only go up to 24kg each and bench is getting easy, should I just go to 40kg
turns.reply:
Jump-starting straight to 40kg per hand is way too big of a leap — that's a 32kg total increase, which is a fast track to dumping the weight or hurting a shoulder. 💪

Instead, take 3 to 4 seconds to lower the weights on every rep. Slowing down the tempo increases the mechanical challenge so those 24s feel heavy again without needing a jump in weight, though we have other ways to tweak this too.

turns.user: so what do I actually do next week
turns.reply:
Next week, keep using your 24kg dumbbells, but lower the weight for a slow 3-to-4-second count and add 2 to 3 reps per set. 

Slowing down the tempo keeps your chest working hard at the top of your current strength without needing heavier kit yet.
